content: Kubernetes reference: a Deployment rolls out replacement pods with a RollingUpdate strategy whose maxSurge and maxUnavailable fields control the pace of replacement.
Kubernetes reference: a StatefulSet keeps stable network identities and stable persistent volume claims for each pod ordinal, which is why databases use one.
Kubernetes reference: a DaemonSet runs one copy of a pod on every node matching the node selector, typically log shippers and node agents.
Kubernetes reference: pod eviction happens when a node hits memory or pid pressure, and the kubelet evicts by priority class.
The settlement worker is pinned to Kubernetes 1.27 and cannot be upgraded until the vendor node agent is removed from the cluster.

Settlement latency alerts fire above 900 ms p99 on the settle_e2e metric.
We keep 35 days of raw settlement events in S3 for reconciliation replay.
The reconciliation replay job runs nightly at 02:15 IST and takes about 40 minutes.
Vendor settlement files arrive over SFTP into the inbound bucket every 15 minutes.
Duplicate settlement detection uses the (psp_reference, capture_sequence) pair as the idempotency key.
We rejected using a global lock on the ledger rows and moved to per-account advisory locks instead.
The staging environment is named preprod and it shares the ap-south-1 region with production.
Grafana dashboards for payments live in the Nimbus Operations folder, not the Platform folder.
Rust error handling in the ledger crate uses thiserror for domain errors and anyhow only at the binary edge.
Our Postgres connection pool caps at 40 connections per pod because the instance maxes at 200.
Chargeback notifications from the acquirer arrive on the acquirer.events webhook topic.
I keep a shared calendar called Nimbus OnCall for handover notes.
The ledger crate's test fixtures are seeded by cargo run --bin seed_ledger.
Weekly payments engineering sync moved to Tuesday 11:00 IST.

The psp sandbox credentials rotate every quarter through the vault rotation job.
I use rg and delta as my daily diff and search tools.
